model_output.rationale: All five 835 lines deny CO-4 + N822 (missing procedure modifier) on always-therapy CPTs 97530/97140/97116 billed with KX only and no GP. CO-4/N822 is returned-unprocessable — no appeal rights; remedy is a new original claim with GP appended alongside KX.

root_cause.explanation: 837P lines 1-5 (97530, 97140, 97116) carry KX only, no GP discipline modifier, though the note documents an outpatient PT plan of care. Remit denies every line CO-4 with RARC N822, missing procedure modifier.

next_action.detail: Append GP to all five lines (keep KX) and send a NEW original claim, CLM05-3 = 1, to Novitas Part B. Do not appeal; do not use frequency 7. Filing clock never stopped — 1 year from DOS 2026-06-05.

evidence.fact: All 5 lines denied CO-4 with RARC N822 (missing procedure modifier), $0 paid
97530, 97140, 97116 billed with KX only; no GP/GO/GN modifier
Therapeutic activities, manual therapy, gait training — outpatient physical therapy plan of care (GP)
CO-4 + N822 on always-therapy CPTs = unprocessable, no appeal rights; correct_and_resubmit as new original CLM05-3=1

citations.rule: CO-4 + N822 on always-therapy CPTs lacking GP/GO/GN → missing_therapy_modifier; new original claim, never appeal, never bill patient
CO on Medicare FFS = provider liability, never billable to the patient
